source: rust/crates/pbo-core/src/transient.rs (the values are those of 1.x: a pause of a second every half minute, bursts of 300 ms load and 100 ms idle)
about: How a test interrupts its load so that the core has to boost back up. 'off' is a steady load, 'periodic:EVERY:PAUSE' freezes the engine for PAUSE seconds every EVERY seconds, 'bursts' freezes and releases it in fractions of a second. 'dutyCycle' is the share of the time the load really runs, which the check that the engine used its core is measured against. 'ofProfile' says how a ready-made list interrupts its load.

cases.name: a steady load runs all the time
bursts run the load three quarters of the time
periodic without numbers is a second every half minute
a pause as long as the period is no pause
a pause of nothing is no pause
the breaking-point list pauses every five seconds
the others pause a second every half minute
